name: Weald Relay
description: End-to-end encrypted relay for a Weald workspace. Stores ciphertext envelopes and routing metadata, holds no key, and has no admin panel because there is nothing an operator could administer.
notes: After the first boot, open the relay's logs and copy the one-time enrollment URL. It expires in 24 hours or on first use, and the first device to open it becomes the workspace trust root.
